purpose: Independent recheck of single-method CPU and small-signature registration tails observed in the initial matrix
safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
memory: Separate retained/peak requested heap diagnostic; per-cycle lifetime cleanup checked. Proc before/after retained in raw data only.
failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
analysis: Eight exploratory independent paired blocks after initial four-arm collection. Do not pool, replace or erase initial results; same client and runtime bytes.
hypothesis: Determine whether +1.56% single-method own CPU and +5.00%/+3.56% small-signature p99 recur in longer independent windows. Shrinking a one-method Vec may add realloc cost; no implementation change in this recheck.
retention_rule: Defer runtime retention if either selected lane has p99 median above +5% with at least six of eight positive pairs, or own CPU median above +1% with at least six positive pairs. These are conservative investigation gates, not significance, equivalence or superiority tests.
build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
client_control: ca1a912 client and dependencies plus frozen CPU-clock patch and register-cycle command; one identical new client for all registration arms. Do not pool with lookup experiment.
